mission: raise event detection recall/bounds honestly, smallest defensible fix per known failure, no threshold hacks without forensic justification

datasetScope.cases: all DEV replayable cases from datasets/paddle-bench/paddle-bench.json + datasets/paddle-bench/event-bounds-wave-a.json (windowed wave-a people.json runDirs plus the W6 replay-validated rally1 fixture)
datasetScope.grouping: per independent source video/session; no random-frame splits; held-out cases never viewed or replayed

forensicBasis.d06Oracle: datasets/experiments/wave-d/d06-summary.json — 0 proven EVENT_LOGIC failures; 3 WRIST_SIGNAL_QUALITY (in-span smoothed wrist peaks 0.31-0.46, under the 0.5 proposal floor), 1 CONTACT_ANCHOR_ABSENT, 3 UNATTRIBUTABLE_HERE
forensicBasis.minProminenceProvenance: minProminence 4 is the pre-existing miner boundary ('is this a stroke at all?', packages/swing-lab/src/mineVideo.ts) — not a new tuned value

change.description: Additive low-amplitude tier (wrist source only): local maxima below the tier-1 floor are admitted only if smoothed peak >= 0.3 AND local prominence >= 4 AND no overlap with any tier-1 proposal. Tier-1 output is never altered. Admitted proposals carry lowAmplitude: true and a -0.15 confidence penalty so downstream consumers see the weaker evidence.
change.contractVersioning: existing tier-1 gates (EVENT_GATES) untouched; new tier is a separate, flagged, penalized proposal class rather than a softened threshold

metrics.criterion: PROPOSED_OK = best proposal overlap >= 0.5 of gold OR gold contact inside proposal +/-60ms (D06 oracle / cascade criterion)
metrics.oracleAfter: WRIST_SIGNAL_QUALITY 3 -> 2; successful proposals 14 -> 15 of 21 gold (full corpus incl. non-replayable); see e01-oracle-after.json

provenNegatives.reason: measured local prominence 2.08 / 2.51 is below the miner stroke boundary (4); admitting them would require lowering the only forensic anchor available and, per D06, these are perception/signal-quality failures, not proven event-logic failures. Left as honest misses rather than tuning the gate to the failures.
provenNegatives.misBoundedRemaining: wavea-sasebo-volleys#1 remains MIS_BOUNDED (overlap 0.37): the adjacent tier-1 proposal spans it partially; fixing bounds there would require re-cutting a tier-1 event without forensic support

falseProposalDisclosure: labeled non-event spans reach smoothed speeds up to 1.785, so the 0.3 floor alone would NOT be safe; safety comes from the prominence gate, measured as 0 proposals inside the 5 explicit non-event spans and 0 unmatched proposals before and after

gates.swing-lab tests: 462 passed | 4 skipped (incl. 3 new low-amplitude tier tests)
